gizmo.title: Indawo yokuwisa yomfanekiso
gizmo.description: Abafundi babeka iilebhile kwiindawo ezibekwe phezu komfanekiso, emva koko bajonge impendulo yabo.

configure.title: Isicatshulwa esingenye indlela
configure.description: Ichaza umfanekiso kubantu abangakwaziyo ukuwubona. Musa ukutyhila apho iilebhile ziya khona.

configure.title: Isihloko somfanekiso
configure.description: Isihloko esifutshane esibonakalayo somfanekiso, esiboniswa ngaphezulu kwawo.

configure.title: Umbuzo
configure.description: Oko abafundi bacelwa ukuba bakwenze ngeelebhile.

configure.title: Iilebhile neendawo
configure.description: Into nganye yilebhile abafundi abanokuyibeka. Nika ilebhile igama lendawo ukubeka indawo yayo kumfanekiso; ilebhile engenagama lendawo yeyongezelelweyo engekho ndawo. Amanani endawo ziipesenti zomfanekiso.

advanced.title: Xuba iilebhile
advanced.description: Bonisa iilebhile ngolandelelwano olwahlukileyo kutyelelo ngalunye.

advanced.title: Iyasongeka
advanced.description: Bonisa lo mbuzo njengomqolo ovulekayo novalekayo. Ukuvula omnye kuvala eminye imibuzo esongekayo ecaleni kwawo.

advanced.title: Qala usongiwe
advanced.description: Xa isongeka, qala njengomqolo ovaliweyo obonisa umbuzo nesimo sawo kuphela.

advanced.title: Ifomathi yokumaka
advanced.description: OER Schema: ifomathi yokumaka yolu vavanyo (umz. amanqaku, unobumba, ipesenti, ukugqitywa).

advanced.title: Injongo yokufunda
advanced.description: OER Schema: injongo yokufunda enxulumene nolu vavanyo.

developer.title: Igama lovavanyo
developer.description: Igama lovavanyo elisetyenziselwa ukuchonga kwe-xAPI kwiinkqubo zohlalutyo.

developer.title: Ikhosi
developer.description: OER Schema: ikhosi olu vavanyo lwenzelwe yona.
